fields.summary: Autonomous plan run, no owner. The planner read internal/api/write_node.go: buildRetire drops a node's pending ops only when the node was created in this change set; for a landed node it writes node.retire with Base n.Version (the landed version), ignoring this change set's pending update or move on that node. At land, model.checkBase (internal/model/apply.go) walks the target's history after the base and reports a conflict against the change set's own earlier update, which is how change set 01M6WMCCRC0K (PR #383) fails to land. The intent prescribes both fixes. One question went to the arbiter, who ruled (assumed, would have escalated) in Decision own-ops-never-stale: checkBase skips history entries of the op's own change set for every node and link op; other change sets' entries after the base still conflict on overlapping aspects, including interleaved ones; the ErrBase and retired-target checks are unchanged. The planner split the work into two leaves: retire drops the change set's pending updates and moves on a landed node and bases the retire on the landed version (model-writes), and an op is never stale against its own change set's ops (conflicts), with a test of the 01M6WMCCRC0K log shape. The change set serves milestone-25, like the other backlog fixes.
fields.title: Plan of fix 01M6XMT: update-then-retire in one change set lands (autonomous)
